# Example Blueprint: SaaS Platform

**System:** Multi-Tenant Project Management SaaS
**Classification:** SaaS Platform, Medium Complexity
**Generated by:** SuperArchitect OS v1.0

---

## 1. System Description

A cloud-based project management platform for small-to-medium teams. Core capabilities: project creation, task management with kanban boards, team collaboration, time tracking, and reporting dashboards. Multi-tenant architecture with per-tenant data isolation.

---

## 2. Requirements Summary

### Functional Requirements (MoSCoW)

**Must Have:**
- User registration, authentication, and team management
- Project CRUD with role-based access (owner, admin, member, viewer)
- Task management: create, assign, status transitions, due dates, priorities
- Kanban board view with drag-and-drop
- Real-time updates (when another user moves a task, others see it)
- Basic reporting: tasks by status, tasks by assignee, overdue tasks

**Should Have:**
- Time tracking on tasks
- File attachments on tasks
- Email notifications for assignments and due dates
- Activity feed (audit log of project changes)
- Search across projects and tasks

**Could Have:**
- Gantt chart view
- Custom task fields
- API for third-party integrations
- Slack/Teams integration
- Mobile-responsive web application

### Non-Functional Requirements
- Availability: 99.9% uptime
- Latency: p95 < 200ms for API responses
- Scale: support 10,000 teams, 100,000 users in year one
- Data isolation: strict per-tenant data separation
- Compliance: GDPR (EU users)

---

## 3. Architecture

### Pattern: Modular Monolith

**Rationale:** Single team building the product. Domain boundaries are understood but may evolve. Operational simplicity is important for a startup. Modular monolith provides clean boundaries without the overhead of distributed systems. Can be decomposed later if needed.

### Module Decomposition

```
src/
  modules/
    auth/           # Authentication, sessions, OAuth providers
    tenants/        # Tenant management, subscription, billing
    projects/       # Project CRUD, settings, members
    tasks/          # Task management, status transitions, assignments
    boards/         # Kanban board state, column configuration
    notifications/  # Email and in-app notifications
    reporting/      # Dashboard queries, report generation
    files/          # File upload, storage, access control
    activity/       # Activity feed, audit log
    search/         # Full-text search across entities
  shared/
    kernel/         # Base types: UserId, TenantId, Timestamp
    middleware/     # Auth, tenant context, rate limiting, logging
    events/         # In-process event bus
    config/         # Application configuration
```

### Technology Stack

| Component | Technology | Rationale |
|-----------|-----------|-----------|
| Language | TypeScript | Team expertise, full-stack consistency |
| Backend Framework | Fastify | Performance, schema validation, plugin ecosystem |
| Database | PostgreSQL 16 | ACID, JSONB for flexible fields, row-level security |
| Cache | Redis 7 | Session storage, real-time pub/sub, rate limiting |
| Object Storage | S3 / MinIO | File attachments, cost-effective |
| Search | PostgreSQL FTS (start) | Sufficient for initial scale, upgrade to Typesense later |
| Real-time | WebSockets (Socket.io) | Kanban live updates, notifications |
| Auth Provider | Auth0 | Managed auth, social login, MFA |
| Email | SendGrid | Transactional emails, templates |
| Hosting | AWS (ECS Fargate) | Managed containers, auto-scaling |

### Data Model (Core Entities)

```sql
-- Multi-tenant: all tables include tenant_id
-- Row-Level Security policies enforce tenant isolation

CREATE TABLE tenants (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  slug VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  plan VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'free',
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE users (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  email VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  auth_provider_id VARCHAR(255) UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE tenant_members (
  tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(id),
  user_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  role VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'member',
  PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, user_id)
);

CREATE TABLE projects (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) NOT NULL,
  name VARCHAR(255) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'active',
  created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

CREATE TABLE tasks (
  id UUID PRIMARY KEY DEFAULT gen_random_uuid(),
  tenant_id UUID REFERENCES tenants(id) NOT NULL,
  project_id UUID REFERENCES projects(id) NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  description TEXT,
  status VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT 'todo',
  priority VARCHAR(20) DEFAULT 'medium',
  assignee_id UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  due_date DATE,
  position INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
  created_by UUID REFERENCES users(id),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW(),
  updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT NOW()
);

-- Row-Level Security
ALTER TABLE projects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY;
CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation_projects ON projects
  USING (tenant_id = current_setting('app.current_tenant_id')::uuid);
```

### API Design (Key Endpoints)

```
POST   /api/v1/auth/login
POST   /api/v1/auth/register
POST   /api/v1/auth/refresh

GET    /api/v1/projects
POST   /api/v1/projects
GET    /api/v1/projects/:id
PATCH  /api/v1/projects/:id
DELETE /api/v1/projects/:id

GET    /api/v1/projects/:id/tasks
POST   /api/v1/projects/:id/tasks
GET    /api/v1/tasks/:id
PATCH  /api/v1/tasks/:id
DELETE /api/v1/tasks/:id
PATCH  /api/v1/tasks/:id/move    # Kanban drag-and-drop

GET    /api/v1/projects/:id/board
WS     /ws/projects/:id           # Real-time board updates

GET    /api/v1/reports/tasks-by-status
GET    /api/v1/reports/tasks-by-assignee
GET    /api/v1/reports/overdue
```

---

## 5. Security

- **Auth:** Auth0 with JWT access tokens (15 min) + refresh tokens
- **Tenant isolation:** PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS)
- **API security:** Rate limiting (100 req/min per user), input validation (Zod schemas)
- **Encryption:** TLS 1.3 in transit, AES-256 at rest (RDS, S3)
- **GDPR:** Data export endpoint, deletion endpoint, consent tracking

---

## 6. Key Decisions (ADRs)

1. **Modular monolith over microservices:** Small team, evolving domain, operational simplicity
2. **PostgreSQL RLS for tenant isolation:** Database-enforced isolation, no application-level mistakes
3. **Auth0 over self-hosted:** Reduced security risk, faster time-to-market
4. **WebSockets for real-time:** Simpler than SSE for bidirectional kanban updates
5. **ECS Fargate over EKS:** Lower operational overhead for small team
